items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: I went to work with Will May and Cook.

ctx.x: Well, you were in, in a, in a strange city.
I mean, the only thing that worried me, I got homesick. And, and, and on the way home, I went to, I went to work with Will May and Cook.
On the way home, what do you mean?
